description: This file defines the I18NDao class which provides data access methods for internationalization-related entities, such as fetching language details and translation messages from the database within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: I18NDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for internationalization entities, providing methods to retrieve language details and translation messages.

methods.name: getLanguageByLangCode
methods.description: Retrieves an I18NLanguage entity based on the language code if it is enabled.

methods.name: getAllTranslationMessagesByLangCode
methods.description: Fetches all translation message units, their source values, translated target values, and associated group names for a given language code.

methods.name: createQueryBuilderWrapperForAllTranslationByLangCode
methods.description: Creates a query builder wrapped with language-specific join conditions for fetching translation messages. Throws InvalidArgumentException if language code is invalid.
